stopping_rules: Never retry a failed/truncated returned batch. Preserve independent-case failures.
Long-table continuation once, only after batch_limit with all returned batches usable and cursor remaining. No automatic split.
Stop all further operations on unknown usage, total limits, changed runtime or unplanned source mutation.
Project update/followup only if original/current edition has usable structural coverage; no semantic success assumption.
acceptance_boundaries: Literal values/status/source checks are separate from delivery and structure. No global semantic pass score.
Blank and unknown permitted values [null,empty string] are declared before calls, not changed after outputs.
Original questions/criteria/outputs and all failures retained; no tuning production to this fixture. Stage12 stays unaccepted.
